description: This file defines the ImportMapAct class, a specialized map for importing ACT! files into SuiteCRM, extending the ImportMapOther class. It includes configuration properties such as delimiter, enclosure, and header presence, and provides a method for retrieving custom field mappings for specific modules like Contacts, Leads, and Accounts.

classes.name: ImportMapAct
classes.description: A class that defines how to map fields from ACT! import files to CRM modules, with specific mappings for Contacts, Leads, and Accounts.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns the field mapping configuration for a given module, augmenting base mappings with module-specific field correspondences.
